findings.title: Production BOM identity is not compared with the native fitted part

evidence.after_genuine_write_manifest: verify_manifest accepts all five hashed outputs; this supplies no semantic identity check
evidence.maker_page: Bourns CRM2512 p1 family and rating; selected exact identity is native R134 and its BOM row. The seed uses the existing native R166 identity.

findings.impact: A wrong physical resistor order can pass the BOM population/quantity detector. The current production row is correct. Original manifest rejection prevents claiming a whole-gate escape.
findings.concrete_fix: In the existing BOM walk, map every row designator to the native fitted LCSC, Manufacturer Part and footprint, and reject mismatches or unexpected members. Preserve quantity-free CPL handling and valid merged BOM rows.

findings.provenance: new scope extension beyond closed R12 terminal/SD coverage
findings.title: Positive scale can shrink the C84 physical fit representation

evidence.maker_page: MA series p2 8x10 dimensions and p4 MA25V470M8X10 electrical row, four-page sheet with no explicit revision seen

findings.impact: The fit detector accepts a representation much smaller than the specified capacitor. Current C84 is full size and no physical collision or full-gate acceptance is demonstrated. Eight terminal/SD positive-shrink controls reject correctly.
findings.concrete_fix: Add the reviewed M3_MA_8x10 normalized physical envelope to the existing R10_MODEL_BOXES validation, with a C84 shrink negative and equivalent-unit positive control. Keep the present conservative dimensions and physical qualification limits.

findings.title: K-fill compares area rather than saved filled geometry

evidence.maker_page: Not applicable: native saved-fill/refill geometry equality is a software invariant, not a maker parameter.

findings.impact: A demonstrably stale saved fill passes its dedicated freshness detector. The target has no demonstrated stale fill; broader native-budget binding rejects the mutant. No whole-gate or manufacturing escape is claimed.
findings.concrete_fix: After native refill compare normalized polygons per zone UUID/layer/net, using symmetric difference or equivalent geometric comparison with an explicit numerical tolerance. Add same-area translation/reshape negatives and unchanged/equivalent-geometry positives.

coverage_limits: Complete present gate reviewed from native/source inputs; this is not a delta review. All116 D IDs through D-R14-03 and22 owner mandate/amendment scopes were considered.
No canonical build, full check.sh, canonical write, Git action, other-worktree edit, subagent or GUI launch was used. Only the two assigned reports and ignored own probes were written.
No current-round peer report or probe was read. Exact CLI pointer and named static maker PDFs only were used for tool/source discovery.
No whole-gate mutant acceptance is claimed; individual genuine detectors and independent broader bindings are distinguished.

Fresh baseline PCB DRC/parity was executed. This lens did not separately rerun ERC, all173 R10 tests, complete hot-plug numerical sweep, full exporter, supplier stock/cost or reproducibility builds. These are not claimed as fresh lens results.

No R10 executable firmware, electrical/thermal/transient/endurance, source/harness/e-match lot, RF/ESD, physical fit/retention or first-article qualification was performed. Correctly disclosed pending qualification alone is not a finding.
Read-only source and maker evidence cannot prove factory BOM acceptance or physical failure from a seed.
Static maker PDF pages were inspected fresh; source links and hashes identify the actual documents.
